description: What happened on a project: milestones proposed, approved, completed or failed, and goal changes. Use it for 'what shipped' questions. Pass since to get only newer entries, oldest first.

project.description: Project id (UUID) or exact project name. Call list_projects to find it.

since.description: ISO-8601 date-time; only entries after it, oldest first.

verbs.description: Only entries with these verbs, such as milestone_completed. Omit for all.

name: list_activity
title: List project activity
